question: Which of the following is the disease caused by bacteria?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Typeweed**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Typeweed** is a disease caused by bacteria.
 
• Bacterial diseases are caused by harmful strains of bacteria that can infect the body, leading to various health issues.
 
• Unlike viral diseases such as Hepatitis A, Polio, and Chicken Pox, bacterial diseases are typically treated
